headline: Argentina Activates $5B Chinese Currency Swap to Guarantee Debt Repayments
summary: Economy Minister Luis Caputo announced that Argentina has activated a $5-billion Chinese currency swap line to guarantee 2027 debt repayments and dispel market doubts.
why: Currency swap lines provide crucial international liquidity support for emerging market sovereign debt obligations.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Access to international liquidity facilities reduces sovereign default risk and bolsters foreign reserves.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Activation of emergency currency swap lines reassures bondholders regarding upcoming sovereign debt servicing obligations.
